package.title: Vulnerability and Clientelism
package.paper_type: Empirical economics: randomized controlled trial (cisterns) + municipal rainfall shocks; panel survey of 1,308 households / 425 neighborhood clusters in 40 municipalities of semiarid Brazil; voting-machine-level electoral outcomes for 2012 municipal elections.

replication_data.referenced_as: Bobonis, Gertler, Gonzalez-Navarro & Nichter 2022, 'Replication Data for: Vulnerability and Clientelism'
replication_data.reason: HTTP 403 (Forbidden) returned by https://doi.org/10.3886/E173341V1, the openICPSR project view, and the AEA supplemental-appendix endpoints; ICPSR/AER bot protection + institutional-login gating. No credentials or GUI browser automation available in this session.

audit.mode: static audit + independent closed-form arithmetic reimplementation (internal consistency); live execution and data-driven regression re-estimation NOT possible (replication data unobtainable in environment)
scope: Main article text + main Tables 1-5 in paper_extracted.txt
NOT in scope (unobtainable): AEA Supplemental Appendix (Tables A1-A10, Figs A1-A2), ICPSR replication data/code

Regression models (as specified in paper: Eq 2: y_ihcmt = alpha_m + gamma_t + beta1*D_cm + eps (requests; cluster-level SE; municipality + year FE)
Eq 3: y_ihcmt = alpha_m + gamma_t + phi1*Z_mt + eps (rainfall shocks)
Eq 4: y_slm = alpha_lm + gamma1*TV_slm + gamma2*EV_slm + gamma3*RV_slm + eps (voting-machine level, location FE, rescaled regressors, CRVE + wild-cluster bootstrap)
Eq 5: heterogeneity by clientelist-relationship marker R (main + interaction)
statistical_conventions_noted: Clustered SE: neighborhood-cluster level (requests), voting-location level (electoral) with wild-cluster bootstrap p-values allowing within-municipality correlation
Rainfall shock standardized: (Rain_imy - mean)/sigma, then standardized to mean 0, var 1 within year
KLK (Kling, Liebman, Katz 2007) standardized index construction for the overall vulnerability index

verification_layer1_internal_consistency.notes: Confirms every checkable proportional claim, binary-SD identity sqrt(p(1-p)), coefficient-sum (main+interaction) identities, and sample/electoral bookkeeping in the article's own reported numbers. One apparent mismatch was traced to an audit-side column mis-mount (Table 5 interaction rows) and corrected; it was NOT a paper inconsistency.

verification_layer3_data_regressions.reason: Replication package (10.3886/E173341V1) not retrievable (HTTP 403). Tables 2-5 regression point estimates and clustered/wild-bootstrap standard errors are therefore marked ➖ (not independently re-estimated) in the numerical reproducibility tables.
